I can't give you an amount for L-carnitine. Dosing any supplement is a call for a doctor or a registered dietitian, who can factor in your health, medications and goals.

As general context, it's a compound the body makes on its own, and it's sold as a supplement mostly for fat loss and endurance. The research behind those claims is mixed. Training consistency, enough protein and sleep will do far more for you than any supplement.

If you tell me what you're after, I can help with the training side of it.
